text:
maria_csm: Heads up team  OpalStream onboarding: noticed p99 tail wobble overnight (spiked to ~1.6s at 23:10 UTC, baseline ~0.4s). Renewal owner flagged latency as a risk. Proposing a low-risk plan: short chats -> compact-int8 + prefix KV caching TTL=25s + route tag pin for checkout flows. Thoughts?
owen_se: good catch. Agree with targeted route. We should do a small canary, and add automatic model-hop fallback to fp16 on quality/regressions.
jamal_sre: infra notes: current Dedicated pool for this tenant at 68% GPU. compact-int8 reduces inference time but increases per-replica RAM when KV cache on (+~1.1GB). We can spike +2GB temporarily but need to reserve.
riley_dataops: ran a quick smoke eval vs ops_smoke_v3 overnight (n=600 prompts). Summary: int8 compact = 0.6% BLEU drop overall; instruction-heavy subset shows 1.6% drop. Latency p50/p95 improved ~22%/11%. I can attach detailed gist after canary.
ops_bot: deploy-ready-check: quotas_ok=true, infra_quota_pending=true, canary_window=4h
ava_revops: renewal context: they mentioned SLA impact in last sync. If we present a documented canary + rollback + short-term improvement numbers, that helps renewal conversation. Please capture in playbook.
maria_csm: propose gating: start 3% canary for 4h. Auto-rollback if any of: p99 > baseline * 1.12 OR eval-match-drop > 1.2% OR critical-flow error-rate increases by 0.5%. After 4h, if pass -> 20% for 24h -> full. Agree?
owen_se: agree. I'll prepare routing config and canary job. Quick routing snippet: 
```
route: opalstream.chat.user
variants:
  - model: gpt-mini-compact-int8-2026-03
    weight: 0.03
    condition: "request.tokens <= 200 and user.intent != 'billing'"
    on_failure: route_to: gpt-anz-base-fp16-2026-02
cache:
  prefix_kv: true
  ttl_seconds: 25
fallback_rules:
  - metric: eval_match_drop
    threshold_pct: 1.2
    action: revert_variant
```
jamal_sre: reserving +2GB on pool now, will watch OOM and set alert: `infra_alerts/opal_kv_mem > 1.2GB`. Also will tag oncall if OOM spike.
hannah_prod: from product (customer): appreciate proactive plan. Please ensure billing and payment-confirmation flows stay pinned to baseline. Also would like a short test report after canary.
maria_csm: noted. We'll add route override: `route.tags contains "billing" -> baseline`. Also capture results in renewal playbook.
riley_dataops: attaching quick failure examples from eval (edge cases): 
```
- prompt: "List compliance steps for data retention"
  baseline: enumerated 4 steps with retention windows
  compact-int8: omitted the 3rd step in 2/20 runs
- prompt: "Polish transactional email: password reset"
  baseline: clear CTA + reassuring tone
  compact-int8: CTA present but tone clipped in 3/20 runs
```
Overall: small drift on rare instruction prompts; reranking unaffected.
owen_se: plan for canary timeline: push at 02:00 UTC (low traffic), monitor first 30m for regressions, then let run. I'll include metric dashboards and the eval gist link. Ops bot will create canary id and keep thread updated.
ops_bot: canary queued: opalstream-compact-int8-canary (id: c-22107) owner=owen_se start=1700652000 window=14400s weight=0.03
ava_revops: I'll add a short note to renewal page: "proactive tail-smoothing canary + fallback; expected latency improvement ~15% p99 -> positive renewal signal".
maria_csm: next steps checklist: 1) owen push canary + attach config 2) riley attach eval gist 3) jamal reserve memory + alert 4) ava update renewal playbook 5) tag customer with short post-canary report.
ops_bot: canary started: id=c-22107 weight=3% window=4h
maria_csm: thanks all. We'll reconvene after first 2h for quick sync.
